scope: Independent shared capacity/deadline audit and preventive preflight; no new GPU model calls in this audit, no edits to live M/O/P frozen runtimes.

implementation.native_context: Resolve model max_position_embeddings or nested text_config; reject missing/invalid capacity, configured input overflow, or native input+unchanged output reserve overflow before generation. Exact fit remains legal.
implementation.planner_output: Flat finite ASCII map only: mandatory JSON-character lower bound divided by maximum tokenizer piece span plus EOS; separately report independently tokenized worst-case estimate. Reject only a proved necessary-lower-bound overflow. The estimate is not a feasibility proof and never alone rejects a shorter legal plan.
implementation.deadline_diagnostics: After generation extract raw/token IDs/input and output counts/capacity, then enforce cooperative deadline. Attach raw_output to SoftDeadlineExceeded and non-EOS failure; existing worker/Meter chain preserves it. Incomplete plans remain failures.

coverage: Native exact fit and one-token overflow
Worst-case estimate overflow does not reject feasible shorter output
Unknown tokenizer pieces do not invent a lower bound

observed_failure.failure: Single-call timeout with total budget remaining, unlike previous N142 total-budget exhaustion

performance_probe.comparison: CPU token-prefix replay is not a controlled GPU runtime comparison; indicates parser CPU is a small portion of this observed call.
performance_probe.compact_wire_reason: Restricting serialization changes generation trajectories and requires separate validation; not silently adopted.

shared_risk.M: Same full-pool planner path; observed successful maximum 127.350115s, close to original ~140s soft stop. Live M not patched.
shared_risk.N: Whole-pool planner remains serial generation to preserve joint selection; dedicated remaining-budget reservation implemented separately by N continuation owner.
shared_risk.O_P: No full-pool evidence_plan operation. Per-sentence extraction/filter/composition and bounded final review have separate paths, already native context+output checks. No evidence here of the same large-plan timeout.
shared_risk.backend_vlm: Generic LocalModels.vlm still checks configured input cap, rather than native input+output. Current real Qwen native128000 versus cfg32768 leaves headroom; future common guard integration is separate.

continuation_review.budget: Original successful temporal total minus failed planner cost is initialization; old failed planner is dependency; both consume original1500, final45 held. No total increase.
continuation_review.cost_separation: Successful historical calls copied once; failed planner removed only from new successful log, retained in original source+continuation metadata and cumulative failure history. Normal scheme4 wrapper adds directory once. New planner/reader calls are measured separately.
continuation_review.provenance: Source tree hash, packet digest, exact planner input/request hash, single failed final planner and no later model call, no pending work; publish only successful complete result.
notes: Frozen CPU check count is scope-specific, not the later aggregate test count.
Historical setup/gate/interruption accounting is spread across handoff snapshots; final reports must retain prior overhead separately.

limits: No guarantee every feasible schema fits8192; a weak necessary lower bound detects only provably impossible capacity, while estimate is diagnostic.
No guaranteed completion within218.28 remaining planner seconds; actual continued model result is required.
